name: Loredana Crisan
title: Chief Design Officer
research_notes: CDO at Figma since Sep 2025. Came from Meta/Instagram (VP Head of Messenger and Instagram DMs, GenAI Products). C-Level design hire signals serious design ops investment. Based in San Francisco.

name: Noah Levin
title: VP of Product Design
research_notes: VP of Product Design at Figma (updated from Head). Oversees product design, UX writing, and UX research. Grew team from 3 to 80+. Now reports up to new CDO Loredana Crisan. Still the day-to-day design org leader.

name: Randy Hunt
title: Head of Design
research_notes: Head of Design at Notion since April 2024. Still current as of mid-2026 — spoke at UXDX USA in May 2026. Focused on skill-based design teams and AI integration. Team of 100M+ user product. Formerly VP Design at Etsy, Head of Design at Artsy and Grab. Based in NYC.

name: Christina (CJ) Jones
title: Head of Design, Generative AI
research_notes: Head of Design for GenAI at Canva — the highest-leverage design role given Canva's AI push. Andrew Green (previous contact) departed Canva in 2026. Canva now has a decentralized multi-head structure. CJ is the best fit given Ryan's AI + design ops angle. Previously at Grab, Allen Institute for AI. Based in Australia.

name: Jonnie Farrell
title: Head of Design, Canva for Business
research_notes: Head of Design for Canva for Business since Jan 2026. Leads design org of 35+ designers across product, research, and content. Enterprise/B2B focus — relevant for design ops at scale. Based in Sydney.

name: Ari Liusaari
title: VP, Head of Design
research_notes: VP, Head of Design at Miro since Jan 2026 — brand new in role, actively shaping the org. Previously VP Design & Brand at Personio, Senior Director at Spotify, Creative Director at frog Design. Award-winning designer based in New York. Very high value to reach as he's building the design org from scratch.

name: Tjard Reimann
title: Head of Design, Growth
research_notes: Still at Miro as Head of Design, Growth. PLG expert, 10+ years product design leadership. Now reports to Ari Liusaari (new VP). Secondary contact — Ari is the primary.

name: Kevin Wong
title: VP of Product Design
research_notes: VP of Product Design at Webflow. Leading the evolution from website builder to multi-product AI-native platform — AI-augmented design ops is directly in scope. Previously at Airbnb, Meta. Based in Seattle.

name: Jorn van Dijk
title: CPO & Co-founder
research_notes: CPO and Co-founder of Framer. No dedicated VP/Head of Design role exists — design vision lives with Jorn and Benjamin den Boer (Head of Product). Framer is design-first by nature; Jorn is the decision-maker for any design leadership hire. Amsterdam-based.

name: Conor Muirhead
title: Head of Product Design
research_notes: Head of Product Design at Linear since June 2025 — relatively new in role. Reports to CEO Karri Saarinen. Previously Head of Design at Rewatch, Lead Designer at 37signals (HEY, Basecamp). Linear grew from ~74 to 130 people in the past year. Conor is a craftsman-first designer — angle on AI-augmented workflows would resonate.

name: Karri Saarinen
title: CEO & Co-founder
research_notes: CEO of Linear with strong design background (ex-Airbnb). Design and product report directly to Karri. Secondary contact — Conor Muirhead is the primary design leadership contact now. Karri still relevant if the goal is to create a new design ops role that doesn't exist.

name: Vlad Zely
title: Head of Product Design
research_notes: Head of Product Design at Pitch as of 2026 (confirmed via Pitch's own website). Pitch is a ~75-person Berlin-based company (remote-first). Design team is small (~3 in design dept per LinkedIn). Lower priority — smaller org, less design ops need.

name: Jaime Mariko McFarland
title: VP, Head of Design
research_notes: VP, Head of Design at Airtable since May 2023. Reports directly to CEO. Leads Product Design, Research, Brand, and Creative. Active speaker on AI transformation — most recently at CPO Summit in Dec 2026 on Airtable's AI-native pivot. Formerly at Slack, Lyra Health. VERY strong alignment with Ryan's positioning. Based in San Francisco.

name: Collin Whitehead
title: VP of Design
research_notes: VP of Design at the new Superhuman (rebranded Grammarly) since Oct 2025. NOTE: The original Superhuman email app (~20 designers) was acquired by Grammarly, which then acquired Coda and rebranded the whole company as 'Superhuman' — now a 920-person productivity platform. Jonas Downey is Head of Design for Superhuman Mail specifically. Collin leads the full design org across all products. Much larger org than original target — design ops need is higher now.

name: Jonas Downey
title: Head of Design, Superhuman Mail
research_notes: Head of Design for Superhuman Mail (the email product) since Jan 2026. Previously at Figma (launched Dev Mode, Figma Sites), Twitter, 37signals. Reports up to Collin Whitehead. Highly respected design craftsman. Lower priority than Collin for an ops-level role.

name: Ian Silber
title: Head of Product Design
research_notes: Head of Product Design at OpenAI since Aug 2023. Previously Product Design Director at Instagram (8 years), then Founding Designer at Artifact and Global Illumination. Back from maternity leave and actively posting about opening design roles — 'bunch of design roles over the next few months.' Perfect timing.

name: Joel Lewenstein
title: Head of Design
research_notes: Head of Design at Anthropic. Spoke at Figma Config and Assembly about Claude Design — 'a tool suite for designers for exploration, ideation, front-end polish.' Design is now a top-level nav item in Claude. Small pod-based org (3-5 people). Pushes PRs. Very AI-native.

name: Meaghan Choi
title: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork
research_notes: Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic. Claude Code hit $2.5B revenue in year one. Spoke at ProductCon NY 2026. Designs in code, not Figma. Small AI-native pod model. Directly relevant to AI-augmented design ops narrative.

name: Katie Dill
title: Head of Design
research_notes: Head of Design at Stripe since Mar 2021. Oversees Product Design, User Research, Content Design, Brand & Marketing Creative, and Web. Previously VP Head of Design at Lyft (150+ person team, 3x growth), Head of Design at Airbnb. Fast Company 100 Most Creative People. Stripe Design team actively hiring.

name: Amy Thibodeau
title: Chief Design Officer
research_notes: CDO at Gusto, on executive leadership team. Built design from scratch at Gusto, now C-level. Recently hired Ximena (Head of Brand from Airbnb/Robinhood), Rebecca Gimenez (Head of Service Design from Airbnb). Actively building out design leadership. Denver office is 226 people. Colorado priority target.

name: Alaine MacKenzie
title: VP of Product Design, AI & Core Experiences
research_notes: VP of Product Design for AI and Core Experiences at Gusto (promoted Nov 2025). Leads ~25 product and content designers. Based in Vancouver but works across Denver and SF. Secondary contact to Amy Thibodeau — Amy is the primary CDO hire.

name: Ryan Donahue
title: VP Product Design
research_notes: VP Product Design at Databricks since Jan 2020. Mission: make data and AI tools simpler and accessible. Building 'the best design team in the world focused on designing for data.' Previously VP Design at Zendesk. $2.6B revenue, 9,875 employees. Denver office = Colorado priority.

name: Henry Modisett
title: VP of Design
research_notes: VP of Design at Perplexity since Sep 2023. Computer science background + deep UX experience. Team designs in React, not Figma. Led design for Comet browser launch. Philosophy: narrowing scope for clarity, speed, trust. Previously at Google and Quora.

name: Matt Bango
title: Chief Design Officer
research_notes: CDO at Brex since Sep 2024. Previously built and led global design org at Palantir for 5+ years. Actively hiring design leaders and staff design engineers. Brex flattened company structure in 2024 — 'doubling down on builders.' Strong AI + fintech design background.

name: Diego Zaks
title: VP Design
research_notes: VP Design at Ramp since Apr 2023. One of Ramp's earliest employees. Actively redesigning what design org looks like in an AI-installed company — making every employee a designer. Anthropic showed up at their office because they were using Claude Code more than Anthropic was. Building new brand team. Directly relevant to Ryan's positioning.

name: Ryan Sims
title: Chief Design Officer
research_notes: First-ever CDO at Duolingo (promoted April 2024). Grew design from 12 to 105+ person team, now growing to 130. Reports to CEO. Design is company's second-largest division. Previously Head of Product Design at Stripe. Actively hiring design directors.

name: Stu Smith
title: Head of Design, Loom Core (Senior Director)
research_notes: Head of Design Senior Director for Loom Core at Atlassian since Sep 2025. Previously led design for Confluence Core, Trello, Jira Work Management. Deep Atlassian product design experience. Loom is being integrated into Atlassian's AI platform (Rovo).

name: Jamie Umpherson
title: Chief Creative Officer
research_notes: CCO at Runway since Feb 2026 (promoted from Head of Creative, Dec 2022). Leads creative direction for AI video and world model platform. Runway grew 52% YoY to 227 people. Artist-first culture. Strong overlap with Ryan's design + AI narrative.

name: Manesh John
title: VP of Design
research_notes: VP of Design at Asana since Jun 2023. Previously led 120+ person UX team at VMware Cloud. Building AI Studio with agentic experiences. Hiring Director of Product Design for core experiences. $790M revenue, 1,954 employees. Strong enterprise AI design ops opportunity.
